# CheckboxGroup

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:checkbox-group` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A native fieldset of Kerf Checkboxes with the group label above, per-choice hints, and hint and error text below, stacked or wrapping like a RadioGroup.

## When to use

Choose any number of a few related options that should stay visible under one group label, with native keyboard behavior and form participation.

- A form asks for any of two to about eight related options under one label, each with a readable label and an optional hint, and every checked value submits under one name.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for one choice among several; use RadioGroup.
- Do not use for a single independent option or a parent with a mixed state; use Checkbox.
- Do not use for settings that apply the moment they change; use Switch.
- Do not use for many short tag-like or wrapping pill choices; use ChoiceChips multiple.

**Alternatives:**

- [Checkbox Group](./wa-checkbox-group.md) (prefer-over)
- [Checkbox](./checkbox.md) (nearest) — Use Checkbox for one independent option, or a mixed parent above its children.
- [RadioGroup](./radio-group.md) (nearest) — Use RadioGroup when exactly one option may be chosen.
- [ChoiceChips](./choice-chips.md) (nearest) — Use ChoiceChips multiple for wrapping pill choices.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/checkbox-group` — exports `CheckboxGroup`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/checkbox-group` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/checkbox-group.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/checkbox-group`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuicheckbox-group) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

- vertical or horizontal

- whole group disabled

- error
- default or compact size

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [Checkbox](./checkbox.md).

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** checked values; choices and their copy; validation and error copy.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: self (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Laid out exactly like a RadioGroup: the label and hint sit on the text column (1px + 8px); each choice's 20px box (18px compact) sits on the group's inline-start edge 8px (7px) before its label; choices stack 8px apart (--kui-space-xs), the same 28px pitch as RadioGroup choices, wrap with a 24px column gap when horizontal, and a choice hint sits directly under its label text.

## Accessibility

- A native \<fieldset> (a group) named by its legend (label), ariaLabel, or labelledBy; each choice is a Kerf Checkbox, a native checkbox inside its \<label>, invisibly over the drawn box. Every checkbox is its own Tab stop and Space toggles it; each checked value submits under name.
- The group's hint and error form its aria-description; an error sets aria-invalid on the group and the danger border on each box. A choice's hint is that checkbox's aria-description. disabled disables the fieldset, and so every checkbox, natively.

The component renders controls inside it, so it cannot sit in the zones of a component whose root is a control or link. (`KUI-V014`)

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-checkbox-group`, `kui-checkbox-group__label`, `kui-checkbox-group__choices`, `kui-checkbox-group__hint`, `kui-checkbox-group__error`.

Never put `kui-checkbox-group`, `kui-checkbox-group__label`, `kui-checkbox-group__choices`, `kui-checkbox-group__hint`, `kui-checkbox-group__error` on an element you write; render `CheckboxGroup` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-neutral-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-text-quiet`, `--kui-color-danger-on-quiet`, `--kui-font-m`, `--kui-font-s`, `--kui-font-xs`, `--kui-layout-item-padding`, `--kui-space-xs`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
